name: Karam Minerals Inc.
summary: Karam Minerals Inc. engages in the acquisition, exploration, and evaluation of mineral resource properties in Canada. It primarily explores for gold. The company owns a 100% interest in the Black Duck project consisting of two mineral titles covering approximately 1,621.9 hectares in south-central British Columbia. Karam Minerals Inc. was incorporated in 2016 and is based in Vancouver, Canada.
